 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-56978  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City of Long Beach as the
  Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of Long Beach
  meeting held Tuesday, April 1, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-56979  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE 25-015; and authorize City
  Manager, or designee, to execute any and all documents, including the Standard
  Offer, Agreement and Escrow Instructions for Purchase of Real Estate with Urban
  Pacific Development Group, LLC, and/or assignee(s), for the sale of City-owned
  surplus property located at 1827 Pacific Avenue (Assessor’s Parcel Number 7209-
  022-900) in the amount of $825,000. (District 7)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 unless extended by the Chair.
